intro: Thunderhorn Cleansing is an essential spiritual rite in Mulgore, charging travelers with purifying the corrupted Thunderhorn Water Well. Armed with a ritual totem prepared by Mull Thunderhorn, adventurers restore the contaminated spring vital to the local tribe. Successful purification earns the heartfelt approval of the Thunderhorn ancestors.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The totem is ready, friend. And again, it is your task to perform the ritual of cleansing.
Go to the Thunderhorn Water Well, north of the village, and use the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem in your ritual. After you do this, return to me.
